name: Architect’s Headband
body:
Aura faint divination; CL 5th; Slot headband; Price 5,000 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This white headband bears the hieroglyph of an ancient dynasty.

EFFECTS

The wearer of the headband gains a +5 competence bonus on Knowledge (engineering) checks and on Perception checks made to detect secret doors.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells detect secret doors; Special creator must have at least 5 ranks in Knowledge (engineering); Cost 2,500 gp
